senses.definition: n.f. silence;—ד׳ = שְׁאוֹל ψ 94:17, יֹרְדֵי ד׳ ψ 115:17; also Is 21:11 מַשָּׂא דּוּמָה oracle of silence, i.e. of concealment, hidden meaning, according to Ew Di, but v. ii. ד׳, 3.
